evo_sonnhammer.title: Sonnhammer & Koonin (2002). Orthology, paralogy and proposed classification for paralog subtypes.
evo_sonnhammer.note: 저자 공개 원문. 사건 기반 정의, 다른 종 사이 paralog, co-ortholog, in-/out-paralog. 교육용 계통수는 강의자가 새로 만든 가상 예시.

evo_ensembl_tree.title: Ensembl: Protein trees
evo_ensembl_tree.note: Gene tree와 species tree의 reconciliation, 중복·종 분화 구분 및 일대다 관계. 공식 문서 검색 색인 본문 확인.

evo_ensembl_types.title: Ensembl: Homology types
evo_ensembl_types.note: 1:1, 1:many, many:many orthology. 화면의 종내 paralog 단순 설명은 일반 정의로 사용하지 않음.

evo_ensembl_loss.title: Ensembl archived documentation: Gene Orthology/Paralogy prediction method
evo_ensembl_loss.note: 중복 이후 소실이 만드는 apparent ortholog 및 within-/between-species paralog의 사건 기준. 2009년 개념 설명용 자료이며 현행 파이프라인 설명으로 쓰지 않음.

evo_ncbi_glossary.title: NCBI BLAST Glossary
evo_ncbi_glossary.note: Homology와 sequence identity/similarity 구분. 강의 계산은 gap 처리와 분모를 따로 정한 교육용 정의.

evo_ebi_sequence.title: EMBL-EBI Training: Primary structure—Why sequence matters
evo_ebi_sequence.note: Identity와 similarity 구분, MSA의 보존 위치. 기능 추정에 대한 과도한 확정 표현은 사용하지 않음.

evo_function.title: Altenhoff et al. (2012). Resolving the Ortholog Conjecture. PLOS Computational Biology.
evo_function.note: Ortholog 기능 유사성은 통계적 경향이며 동일 기능의 보장이 아님. 기능 주석 편향을 고려한 원연구.

evo_ebi_msa.title: EMBL-EBI Training: Multiple sequence alignment
evo_ebi_msa.note: MSA 행·열·gap 및 정렬의 불확실성에 대한 공식 교육 자료. 짧은 서열과 실습은 강의자가 작성.

evo_ebi_pairwise.title: EMBL-EBI Training: Pairwise sequence alignment
evo_ebi_pairwise.note: 정렬, gap, 삽입·결실 및 비교 위치 개념. 좌표 대응 예시는 교육용 가상 자료.

evo_ncbi_fasta.title: NCBI: BLAST QuickStart—Query and Database Sequence Formats
evo_ncbi_fasta.note: FASTA의 > 헤더와 단일문자 아미노산 서열. 강의의 가상 FASTA는 실제 생물학적 서열이 아님.

evo_hhsuite.title: HH-suite official wiki: Multiple sequence alignment formats and model format
evo_hhsuite.note: A3M 대문자 match·소문자 insert·- deletion, 삽입 빈칸 생략. HH-suite entropy 기반 Neff는 재가중 합 정의와 구별.

evo_morcos.title: Morcos et al. (2011). Direct-coupling analysis of residue coevolution captures native contacts across many protein families. PNAS.
evo_morcos.note: 원연구의 Meff는 80% 초과 동일성 이웃 수(자기 자신 포함)의 역수 가중치 합. 강의는 재가중 계산 원리만 가상 예시로 설명.

evo_covariation.title: Rodriguez Horta & Weigt (2021). On the effect of phylogenetic correlations in coevolution-based contact prediction in proteins.
evo_covariation.note: 단일 열과 두 열 분포, 계통 상관과 구조 접촉 추론의 구분. 공변이를 직접 접촉으로 단정하지 않는 근거.

evo_weighting.title: Hockenberry & Wilke (2019). Phylogenetic Weighting Does Little to Improve the Accuracy of Evolutionary Coupling Analyses.
evo_weighting.note: 재가중이 계통적 비독립성을 완전히 제거한다는 해석 방지. Neff는 정확한 독립 표본 수나 예측 정확도 보장값이 아님.

coevo_miyazawa.title: Miyazawa (2013). Prediction of Contact Residue Pairs Based on Co-Substitution between Sites in Protein Structures. PLOS ONE.
coevo_miyazawa.note: 원연구의 구조·기능 제약, 치환의 물리화학적 보상, 계통 가지의 치환 추론 및 직접·간접 효과 구분. 강의 D/K 표는 원논문의 데이터가 아닌 가상 조합 예시이며 실제 진화 순서나 접촉을 뜻하지 않음. 2026-09-17 원문 확인.

coevo_pairing.title: Gandarilla-Pérez et al. (2023). Combining phylogeny and coevolution improves the inference of interaction partners among paralogous proteins. PLOS Computational Biology.
coevo_pairing.note: 복합체 co-MSA 행의 대응, 같은 종의 여러 paralog가 만드는 파트너 모호성, orthology 이용과 depth 감소의 균형. 논문의 benchmark는 특정 pairing 가정을 사용하므로 일반적인 정확도 보장으로 설명하지 않음. 2026-09-17 원문 확인.

confidence_afdb.title: AlphaFold Protein Structure Database: FAQ and confidence interpretation
confidence_afdb.note: Official AFDB explanation of predicted lDDT-Cα, local confidence and limitations of chain/domain placement; checked 2026-09-17.

confidence_af2_code.title: Google DeepMind AlphaFold2: confidence.py
confidence_af2_code.note: Official implementation: per-residue pLDDT expectation ×100, category boundaries 50/70/90, expected PAE from predicted error bins; checked 2026-09-17.

afcluster_paper.title: Wayment-Steele et al. (2024), Predicting multiple conformations via sequence clustering and AlphaFold2
afcluster_paper.note: Nature 625, 832–839. Online 2023-11-13; volume year 2024. AF-Cluster, KaiB examples; original research. CC BY 4.0.

afcluster_code.title: AF-Cluster author repository and ClusterMSA.py
afcluster_code.note: Live checked 2026-09-17. Removes query from sequence clustering, then prepends original query to each cluster output. README points to ColabDesign notebook; implementation details are version dependent.

afcluster_critique.title: Schafer et al. (2025), Sequence clustering confounds AlphaFold2
afcluster_critique.note: Nature 638, E8–E12; Matters Arising, published 2025-02-19. Reports CF-random comparison and questions the proposed evolutionary-coupling explanation. Interpret alongside original paper and authors response.

afcluster_response.title: Wayment-Steele et al. (2025), Does Sequence Clustering Confound AlphaFold2?
afcluster_response.note: Journal of Molecular Biology 437(21), 169376; online 2025-08-06. Primary author response using additional controls. PubMed record verified: https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/40780395/ . Does not settle method superiority for all targets.

subsampling_paper.title: del Alamo et al. (2022), Sampling alternative conformational states of transporters and receptors with AlphaFold2
subsampling_paper.note: eLife 11:e75751. Row subsampling and template tests on a limited transporter/GPCR benchmark; diverse structures can include misfolded outliers. CC BY 4.0.

subsampling_code.title: delalamo/af2_conformations author repository
subsampling_code.note: Primary implementation linked by eLife paper. Used conceptually; no GPU inference performed for this lesson.

speach_paper.title: Stein and Mchaourab (2022), SPEACH_AF: Sampling protein ensembles and conformational heterogeneity with Alphafold2
speach_paper.note: PLOS Computational Biology 18(8):e1010483. In silico alanine editing based on structural contacts; not equivalent to unknown-residue masking. Original method also modifies query; gaps retained. CC BY.

speach_code.title: SPEACH_AF author notebook: SPEACH_AF_scan.ipynb
speach_code.note: Live checked 2026-09-17. Original notebook iterates from row zero, edits selected non-gap positions to A, and writes modified query and MSA. Important exception to the query-preserving classroom exercise.

afsample2_paper.title: Kalakoti and Wallner (2025), AFsample2 predicts multiple conformations and ensembles with AlphaFold2
afsample2_paper.note: Communications Biology 8, 373; 2025-03-05. Random MSA-column masking to X while excluding target first row, with inference dropout. Figure 1 contrasts row subsampling and column masking; results depend on target and settings. CC BY 4.0.

afsample2_code.title: wallnerlab/AFsample2 author repository
afsample2_code.note: Live checked 2026-09-17. Documents prediction and model-analysis stages, precomputed MSA, masking, dropout, and alternative methods. Read implementation/version when reproducing papers; no GPU run here.

af3_paper.title: Abramson et al. (2024), Accurate structure prediction of biomolecular interactions with AlphaFold 3
af3_paper.note: Nature 630, 493–500. AF3 covers multiple molecular types; paper discusses dynamics/conformation-coverage limitations. AF2 method benchmarks cannot be assumed to apply unchanged.

af3_input.title: Google DeepMind AlphaFold 3 input documentation
af3_input.note: Live checked 2026-09-17. Local AF3 allows custom A3M MSA; first sequence must equal target, uppercase/gap aligned lengths must match. Header organism metadata may affect multimer MSA pairing; a name such as open is not a state command.

afsample3_code.title: wallnerlab/afsample3 research implementation
afsample3_code.note: Repository existence checked 2026-09-17. An AF3 adaptation exists; this lesson does not assert independent benchmark validation or universal superiority based on repository availability.

ebi_plddt.title: EMBL-EBI / Google DeepMind training: pLDDT, Understanding local confidence
ebi_plddt.note: pLDDT estimates local structural confidence; high local confidence does not determine domain placement or state population.

ebi_pae.title: EMBL-EBI / Google DeepMind training: PAE, A measure of global confidence
ebi_pae.note: PAE is predicted positional error after alignment on another residue, in angstroms. Read relevant inter-domain blocks; not a dynamics timescale or population.

ebi_inputs.title: EMBL-EBI / Google DeepMind training: AlphaFold2 inputs and outputs recap
ebi_inputs.note: Templates, multiple seeds, recycles and confidence outputs. Accessed 2026-09-17.

core_af2.title: Jumper et al. (2021), Highly accurate protein structure prediction with AlphaFold

core_af3.title: Abramson et al. (2024), Accurate structure prediction of biomolecular interactions with AlphaFold 3

core_af3_input.title: AlphaFold 3 official input documentation
core_af3_input.note: Custom A3M, external paths, explicit empty fields; checked 2026-09-17

core_af3_output.title: AlphaFold 3 official output documentation
core_af3_output.note: Coordinates, per-atom pLDDT, token PAE, per-seed outputs

core_calm.title: UniProt P0DP23, human calmodulin-1
core_calm.note: Canonical sequence retrieved https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/P0DP23.fasta on 2026-09-17, 149 residues including initiating methionine

core_colab_faq.note: GPU runtime selection, resource availability and runtime limits; checked 2026-09-17
